Bill.BriefDescription: Making loans under chapter 31.45 RCW to military borrowers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to making loans under chapter 31.45 RCW to militaryborrowers; and adding a new section to chapter 31.45 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 31.45 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A licensee shall: (a) When collecting any delinquent small loan, not garnish anywages or salary paid for service in the armed forces; (b) Defer for the duration of the posting all collection activityagainst a military borrower who has been deployed to a combat or combatsupport posting or the spouse of a military borrower for the durationof the posting; (c) Not contact the military chain of command of a militaryborrower in an effort to collect a delinquent small loan; (d) Honor the terms of any repayment agreement between the licenseeand any military borrower or the spouse of a military borrower,including any repayment agreement negotiated through militarycounselors or third party credit counselors; and p. 1 SSB 5415 (e) Not make a loan to a person that the licensee knows is amilitary borrower or the spouse of a military borrower, from a specificlocation that a military base commander has notified the licensee inwriting is designated offlimits to military personnel. (2) For purposes of this section, "military borrower" means anyactive duty member of the armed forces of the United States, or anymember of the national guard or the reserves of the armed forces of theUnited States who has been called to active duty.
